data.name: Delicious - Emily's Miracle of Life
data.detailed_description:
Join Emily for a very special chapter of her life! One thing's for sure, her family will never be the same again after this...

Right after Emily starts her very own cooking video blog, she receives some heart-warming news... She's expecting a new bundle of joy! But how's Emily going to combine everything that's going on in her life with getting ready for the baby? 👶 🍼

🍼 WELCOME THE NEW DELICIOUS FAMILY MEMBER and be a part of this heart-felt stage in Emily's life
🍼 PLAY 60 TOUCHING TIME MANAGEMENT LEVELS and 30 extra challenging bonus levels
🍼 GUIDE EMILY THROUGH HER PREGNANCY and witness her many ups and downs first hand
🍼 DISCOVER 6 DIFFERENT LOCATIONS and visit Emily's Kitchen, a Yoga Studio, a Day Care Center and other super cute baby-related places
🍼 HANG OUT WITH EMILY'S FRIENDS AND FAMILY and say hi to Angela, François and Allison, plus many others
🍼 CUSTOMIZE THE NEW NURSERY and surprise Emily with the perfect baby room
🍼 TRY NEW FEATURES LIKE DAILY CHALLENGES and take on a new challenge level every day
🍼 CREATE YOUR OWN DELICIOUS POSTCARDSand earn all the trophies to share special messages with your loved ones

Will you be there for Emily when she needs you most?

Having your very own cooking video blog and sharing delicious family recipes with the rest of the world doesn't come easy. 🎥 🍝 It's hard work - and with a family like Emily's, you never know what might happen...

On top of everything, Emily's really tired and hasn't been feeling well lately. She and Patrick have been trying to have another baby, but without any success. Is it simply not in the cards for them? Yet just as they try to accept this, Emily receives some life-changing news... She's not feeling well, because she's pregnant! 👶

Emily and Patrick couldn't be happier! But how are they going to manage everything that's going on? Preparing for the baby, filming the cooking vlog, handling their over-excited family... They could use a hand!

Help Emily through this emotional rollercoaster and get ready to experience the miracles of life! ❤

reviews.review:
This is a neutral review, but I'm going to give it a thumbs up since it has some good levels. I have played all of Emily's games and most of the Gamehouse series; this is by far the toughest one to get three stars in each level, and you can't choose the difficulty. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3801770278

The story is about Emily and her family after they moved into their house in the previous game; now she is busy hosting a live cooking show from her kitchen and laptop. After so many years of trying to conceive, she is finally pregnant, but since they've spent most of their money on their house, she and her husband, Patrick, struggle to purchase the necessary items for their new baby. The more you play, the more surprises will be revealed. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3801770303

Usually in those games you play as Emily, but this time, you've got new people in each stage to play as. I loved the first two stages; the rest was too painful to finish, especially the hospital and day care stage. The characters were too lame and dramatic, the kids were annoying, and on top of all of that, the mini-games were too difficult to finish while taking care of the customers; their hearts dropped too fast even when you purchased all the bonuses. I doubt anyone was able to get 3 stars at each stage, and forcing us to play a daily challenge to earn gems to purchase upgrades for the baby's room is a real turn-off; I disliked that. 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3801770233

The soundtracks were really good, and the graphics were as well; while the game is filled with pregnant women, it still looked good and colorful. Upgrading the shop is not easy, as you must play the stage multiple times to earn three stars; the customers are not easy to please. 

Pros:
+Beautiful, colorful graphics.
+Lots of new characters.
+Nice soundtracks.
+Good game length. (50 stages)
+Postcards (You get one for each achievement)
+ Steam Cloud.
+Steam achievements.

Cons:
- Needs a custom mouse cursor (Sometimes you can't see the default small system cursor when the stage is busy)
- Mini-games don't pause the other customers; they lose hearts quickly.
 -You can't choose difficulty (This game is quite difficult compared to the previous ones)
-Daily challenge (You need those if you aim for furnishing the baby's room achievements)


I found myself stressed at each stage rather than relaxed; it was too hectic. The only reason I finished playing it was that I wanted to know what would happen next. The story is good, but the gameplay lacks, and I won't consider it a relaxing game at all. They need to fix the difficulty.
